seo.title: About | HTH (Hub to Hub)
seo.description: Why we're called Hub to Hub, how we work remotely across time zones for clients in Pakistan, the US, the UK and the Gulf.

hero.heading: We build the routes between the parts of your business.
hero.body: Most businesses already have the pieces: a website, a CRM, ad accounts, a WhatsApp number, maybe a store. What they don't have is the route between them. That's what we build.

story.heading: Why Hub to Hub
paragraphs: Every part of a business is a hub. The website is where people arrive. The CRM is where they're tracked. Ads bring them in, chat and calls answer them, the store takes the money.
Each of those hubs usually works fine on its own. The losses happen in between: the form that never reached the CRM, the missed call nobody returned, the ad that got credit for a sale it didn't make.
We named the agency after that gap. Our job is to connect hub to hub, so a lead moves from first click to closed sale without waiting on anyone to copy, paste or remember.

items.title: Your accounts, your data
items.detail: We build inside your CRM, ad, hosting and store accounts. If we part ways, you keep everything.

items.title: Map before we build
items.detail: You approve a written map of the system before any build starts, so there are no surprises in the invoice or the result.

items.title: Measured on sales
items.detail: We report on booked calls, orders and revenue by source, not clicks and impressions.

items.title: Documented by default
items.detail: Every workflow, agent and integration is documented so your team, or anyone else, can run it.

remote.heading: Remote, across four regions
remote.body: We work with clients in Pakistan, the US, the UK and the Gulf. Being remote is how we're set up, not a compromise.

points.title: A daily overlap window
points.detail: We agree a fixed window each day when we're online together for calls and quick decisions.

points.title: Async by default
points.detail: Progress arrives as short Loom videos and written updates, so nothing waits for a meeting.

points.title: One shared board
points.detail: Every task, its status and its owner live on a board you can see at any time.
